parts.html: The K-44 kitchen is a modern minimalist L-shaped model built on a calm combination of gray-beige shades, a natural-looking wood texture, and a striking stone-effect decor. Thanks to its neutral color palette, the kitchen looks understated and architectural, while the wood-grain upper fronts warm up the composition and help avoid the feel of an overly cold minimalism.

The main body of the cabinetry is finished in a light gray-beige shade close to greige. This color works well in contemporary interiors because it combines the softness of beige with the restraint of gray. The tall side units and the lower row of cabinets form a calm, light base, against which the wood-grain upper cabinets become the main visual accent.

The central upper row is finished in a warm gray-brown wood palette. The pronounced wood grain adds depth to the interior and makes the kitchen feel more natural. At the same time, the composition retains its clean geometry and minimalist character without excessive decoration.

The countertop and wall panel feature a stone texture with fine light veining. This visually unifies the work area and creates the effect of a single continuous surface. The standard countertop, however, is chipboard-based; the stone texture refers to the decorative finish and does not mean that natural stone is used.
Layout and dimensions

The K-44 has an L-shaped configuration, with the work surface running along two adjoining walls. This makes efficient use of the corner of the room and allows a convenient layout of the cooking, washing, storage, and built-in appliance zones.
The total length of the kitchen is 5.3 linear meters; the standard overall dimensions are 5.3 × 2.5 × 0.6 m.

In the visualization, the work area occupies the central and corner parts of the composition. On the right is a tall cabinet block for built-in appliances. It houses an oven and a microwave, so the appliances are integrated into the cabinetry without breaking the overall geometry of the fronts.

Tall pantry units increase storage capacity and allow for separate sections for large kitchenware, food supplies, and built-in equipment. Their placement can be adjusted when the model is adapted to a specific room.
An island is not included in the standard K-44 configuration. The L-shaped run of cabinets handles all the main kitchen functions.
Front and carcass materials
One of the key differences between the K-44 and many other standard models is the use of different materials for the upper and lower fronts.
The lower fronts are made of MDF-based acrylic panels. This material provides a smooth, modern surface and is well suited to minimalist furniture with clean geometry.
The upper fronts are made of laminated chipboard. In the visualization, they have a wood-grain decor that contrasts with the light lower part of the kitchen.
The carcass is made of 18 mm thick laminated chipboard.
This combination preserves the efficient construction of a standard model while bringing different textures into a single composition.
Countertop and work area
The standard K-44 countertop is chipboard-based.
In the visualization, it has a gray-brown stone decor with light veining. The wall panel echoes the same visual motif, so the work area reads as a single cohesive interior element.
With a custom order, the countertop material and finish can be changed. Both more budget-friendly and premium options are available, but they are considered add-on configuration items.
Hardware
For hinged fronts, the standard configuration includes Muller Profi Line hinges with a soft-close mechanism. They ensure that doors close smoothly and are part of the K-44 base specification.
Drawers run on the Muller Box Profi Line system.
A cargo pull-out is included in the standard configuration. It provides additional pull-out storage for groceries, bottles, jars, and other kitchen essentials.
Cabinet handles are also included. The visual concept uses dark handles and profile elements that contrast with the light fronts.
Lift-up mechanisms are not included in the standard configuration.
Built-in appliances
The K-44 kitchen is designed for built-in appliances.
This makes it possible to plan the necessary cabinet niches in advance for the oven, microwave, refrigerator, cooktop, and other appliances.
Important: the term “built-in appliances” refers to the way they are installed. The appliances themselves are not automatically included in the base price of the furniture.
At the client’s request, DUMSKAYA DESIGN can also help select kitchen appliances, a range hood, sink, faucet, and plumbing fixtures.
What the standard configuration includes
The base furniture concept includes carcasses, toe kicks, fronts, the countertop, fasteners, cabinet hardware, hinges, drawers, a dish drying rack, and handles.
Lighting can be added separately and is priced according to the chosen configuration, type of lighting, and kitchen dimensions.
Custom adaptation of the K-44
Although the K-44 is presented as a standard model, it can be adapted to a specific room.
You can change the dimensions of individual sections, the cabinet layout, the configuration of the tall pantry units, the placement of built-in appliances, and the interior storage organization.
You can also adjust the balance of light and wood-grain fronts, choose a different wood shade, change the color of the solid-color surfaces, or select a different countertop pattern.
Additional hardware and alternative materials
The standard K-44 specification remains the baseline configuration.
At the client’s request, the kitchen can be equipped with more functional cabinet hardware, additional mechanisms, and expanded interior storage systems.
Alternative materials are also available, from budget to premium. Depending on the project, the front materials, countertops, interior fittings, and individual structural elements can be changed.
All such solutions are additional options and are priced separately.

Overall dimensions: 5.3 × 2.5 × 0.6 m

Lift-up mechanism: None
Island: No
Cargo pull-out: Yes
Appliance installation type: Built-in
Handles: Included
Upper front type: Laminated chipboard, wood-grain decor
Lower front type: MDF-based acrylic panel
Carcass type: Laminated chipboard, 18 mm
Hinges: Muller Profi Line soft-close
Slide / drawer system type: Muller Box Profi Line
Decor: Solid-color in the base specification, with a wood accent in the visual concept
Additional features shown in the visualization: Light tall pantry units, wood-grain upper row, stone-effect countertop and backsplash, built-in oven and microwave, dark profile elements.
Custom K-44 kitchen in Bratislava and Vienna
DUMSKAYA DESIGN offers design, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation of kitchen furniture in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-44 can be used as a standard model or adapted to the dimensions of a specific room. Once the layout, dimensions, materials, and configuration are confirmed, a custom price quote is prepared.
